features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Hero section with couple names (Xuân Tùng & Vân Anh), event details (tiệc đãi khách 08/06/2026, lễ thành hôn 09/06/2026, Sân đình thôn Gia Lương, Đông Anh, Hà Nội), Google Maps embed, and CTAs for RSVP and Our Story
features.evidence: Landing page hero, event cards, venue map embed, RSVP anchor section, and /story placeholder route implemented. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: Our Story
features.description: Chapter-based scroll storytelling with 10 chapters covering 10 years (2016–2025), each with title, images, text, and Framer Motion animations (fade-in, slide-up, zoom)
features.evidence: Story page now renders 10 scroll-based chapters for 2016-2025 with Vietnamese placeholder copy, 39 image slots, reduced-motion-safe Framer Motion reveals, and lazy-loaded route shell. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: Guest Personalization
features.description: URL-based guest personalization (?g=<id>), showing personalized greeting, message, and optional photo. Graceful fallback for unknown guests
features.evidence: Landing page now supports `?g=<guestId>` personalization with typed static guest lookup, personalized greeting/message, highlighted guest name in invitation text, optional photo rendering, and graceful fallback for unknown guests. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: RSVP System
features.description: RSVP form with name + 2 event checkboxes (tiệc đãi khách 8/6, lễ thành hôn 9/6), submitting to Google Apps Script, with success/error feedback
features.evidence: Implemented lib/api.ts (submitRsvp, RsvpFormData, RsvpPayload, RsvpApiResponse), components/rsvp/rsvp-form.tsx (validation, submit states, success/error UI), components/rsvp/index.ts barrel. Replaced placeholder in rsvp-section.tsx with real form. Apps Script contract documented in docs/product-specs/feat-004-rsvp-system.md. Verified pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build on 2026-05-06.

features.name: Performance & Mobile Optimization
features.description: Image optimization (WebP/AVIF, Next.js Image), dynamic imports for heavy components, mobile-first responsive design, <2s initial load target
features.evidence: Added feat-005 product spec, guest image `sizes`, deferred-load venue map CTA, and reduced story placeholder animation density. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm build on 2026-05-05. Deferred: full WebP/AVIF rollout blocked on real production photos; logged in docs/exec-plans/tech-debt-tracker.md. All currently shippable acceptance criteria satisfied.

features.name: Error & Navigation Pages
features.description: Custom 404 page, error boundary, and loading states for graceful UX when routes are not found, components fail, or content is loading
features.evidence: Implemented not-found, error, global-error, loading, and story/loading pages with wedding-themed design. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: SEO & Social Sharing
features.description: robots.txt, sitemap generation, comprehensive Open Graph metadata, and JSON-LD structured data for wedding event so invitation links render rich previews when shared
features.evidence: Implemented robots.ts, sitemap.ts, OG metadata for both pages, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD Event schema, and placeholder OG image. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: Story Animation Polish
features.description: Per-image reveal animations (fade-in, gentle zoom) for story chapter photos with scroll-triggered Framer Motion effects, deferred from feat-005 for mobile performance
features.evidence: Per-image fade-in + gentle zoom animation in StoryImageSlot using Framer Motion whileInView with useReducedMotion() guard. No stagger. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: Accessibility Compliance
features.description: Comprehensive accessibility audit and fixes: ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, color contrast verification, focus management, and semantic HTML improvements
features.evidence: Skip-to-content link, ARIA landmarks, screen reader announcements, color contrast fixes, semantic HTML improvements, focus management. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: Homepage Floating CTA
features.description: Mobile-first floating action button for 'Xem hành trình' to improve story discovery on mobile devices
features.evidence: Implemented components/shared/floating-cta.tsx using Framer Motion for scroll-based reveal. Fixed to bottom on mobile. Verified with ./init.sh on 2026-05-06.

features.name: Gift Registry
features.description: Gửi quà cưới section with bank QR codes and account details for guests who cannot attend or wish to send gifts online
features.evidence: Implemented components/event/gift-registry-section.tsx with two-column layout (desktop), stacked (mobile), copy-to-clipboard account numbers. Verified with pnpm build on 2026-05-06.

features.name: Footer Thank You
features.description: Elegant footer section with a thank you message from the couple to conclude the homepage experience
features.evidence: Implemented components/shared/footer.tsx with couple names, date, and thank you message in wine theme. Verified with pnpm build on 2026-05-06.

features.name: Background Audio Player
features.description: Background music player with toggle control, persistent across routes, using external MP3 source
features.evidence: Implemented components/shared/audio-player.tsx in root layout. Volume 0.2, top-right floating button with spinning music note icon. Autoplay attempted on mount. Verified with ./init.sh on 2026-05-06.

features.name: Guest Sheet + RSVP API (GET/POST with Slug)
features.description: Migrate guest data to Google Sheets with build-time fetch script. Slug-aware RSVP AppScript (GET + POST). RSVP form pre-fills for returning guests.
